To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

attitude toward SMS ads has positive relationship with behavioral intention toward SMS ads, and behavioral intention toward SMS advertising has positive relationship with post behavior toward SMS ads.
attitude toward SMS advertising is a significant predictor of intension to use SMS advertising, and intension is a significant predictor for post behavior.
attitude toward SMS ads is a significant determinant of behavioral intensions.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the attitude toward SMS ads and derived behavior intension among mobile users in two major cities in Iran.
the attitude toward mobile advertising and its effects on intension and post behavior.
the development and validation of a measurement model to measure attitude toward SMS advertising based on TPB.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the attitude toward sms ads has a direct and indirect effect on the behavioral intension and post behavior of the customers.
the attitude toward SMS advertising has a direct positive impact on behavioral intention, which is in turn a significant predictor of the actual SMS advertising behavior.
the attitude toward SMS advertising is a good predictor for the behavioral intension and post behavior.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, attitude toward advertising has positive effects on intention and post behavior, and intention toward advertising has positive effect on post behavior.
, the more positive attitudes toward mobile advertising, the greater the intention to engage in the behavior and the more likely the behavior will occur.
, attitude toward mobile ads is a good predictor for intension and post behavior.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, the mobile marketing is not yet popular in Iran.
, attitude toward mobile advertising is important in predicting intension and post behavior.
, the use of SMS advertising is an efficient tool for marketing.
